scope: Qualitative example from the first scheduled permuted Astra trial; selected after observing its outcome, not a rate estimate

arguments.evidence: The broad visible face has two dots, adjacent faces show one and three; no skill association is established. Probe skill 3, which has the lowest local estimated error.
Skill 3 exposes a clear six-dot upper face, not the requested two. Two dots are visible on the lower adjoining face. Probe skill 1 to establish another association.

After probing skill 1, the broad upper face clearly shows exactly two diagonal dots; the adjoining lower face shows four. This visually grounds skill 1 to the requested face despite inconsistent error estimates.

manual_image_review.request_02.png: Six pips clearly visible on the broad face after skill 3.
manual_image_review.request_03.png: Two pips clearly visible on the broad face after skill 1; four on the adjoining lower face.

interpretation: The agent probes physical skills before binding the two-pip target to skill 1. These probes are not wrong-to-correct semantic bindings. Images agree with the reported evidence in this one episode.
limitations: A single successful case does not estimate reliability or establish causality.
The evaluator receives the mapping for task construction and scoring; the agent receives no mapping table. Full input audit must remain the supporting check.
